translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Per ḻekzka' ladj beṉ' Israelka' wzoa beṉ' wxiye', wnazgake' chyix̱je'gake' daa goll Chioza' ḻegake'. Na' ka'kzə ladjlena' soa beṉ' wli' wsedi de wxiye'ka'. Na' wli' wsedgakile' le' ka ki gakbe'zile' de wxiye' c̱he'ka' daa chlliayi' beṉ'. Na' wzoagake' ka'lə X̱anchona', beena' wdixj saaxya c̱he'ka'. Na' daa gongake' ka', tolbe' kwiayi'gake'.
Beṉ' zan gongake' txen dii mal c̱he'ka' na' gongake' dii zban daa nazan c̱hegake'. Na' ni c̱hegake' iṉe beṉ' zban c̱he dill' ḻi c̱he Chioza' daa nocho.
Daa selall'gake' gat' kwe'gakile', wli' wsedgakile' le' daa chyiljlall'zgake'. Kani'teyi ba nchogbia' c̱hegake' kwiayi'gake', na' bich gakxen c̱hegake'.
Chioza' bi wxi'xene' c̱he anjlka' bx̱iṉj, san btakw bc̱heje' ḻegake' lo yel c̱hoḻa' latja' gana' nseje' ḻegake', na' nan' nkweze' ḻegake' ax̱t kat' illin lla wc̱hogloe' c̱hegake'.
Ni bi wxi'xene' c̱he beṉ' yell-lioka' kani'yi, san bene' yejsiw' wala' blliayee beṉ' malka'. Per dii Noéna', beena' wdix̱je'i beṉ' nan chiyaḻ' gongake' wen, Chioza' bisle'ne' len zi gall beṉ'.
Ḻekzka' Chioza' bc̱hogloe' c̱he beṉ'ka' lle' yell Sodómana' na'ch yell Gomórrana', na' bzey btie' yellka' ax̱t ka biyakgakan de, kwenc̱he ile'i beṉ' ka gak c̱he beṉ' malka'.
Per bisle' dii Lota', beena' gok beṉ' wen, beena' bwiyi dii zbanka' ben beṉ' malka'.
Na' beṉ' wenni wzoa ladje'ka', gokyeshii ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'ena' ni c̱heyi dii malka' ble'ile' bengake' yog' lla.

Yog'ḻoḻ diiki chli'gakan nan X̱anchona' ṉezile' nak gone' yisle' beṉ'ka' chon ka chazlallee lawi bittezə dii lallj. Na' ḻekzka' ṉezile' nak wkweze' beṉ' malka' ax̱t kat' illin lla wc̱hogloe' c̱he yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'.

Na' dii llialote wsak'zi'ch X̱anchona' beṉ'ka' choe' cho'a xbayi beli chen c̱he'ka' daa nxiṉj yic̱hjlall'do'eka', na' bi cheentegakile' no iṉabia' ḻegake'. Beṉ'ka' bibi nalli na' nakgake' beṉ' cha'sib, na' ni bi chllebgake' iṉegake' c̱he anjlka'.
San anjlka', ḻa'kzi nakchgake' beṉ' walch na' napchgake' yeḻ' wak xench, bi chiyaxjgakile' iṉegake' c̱he anjlka' bi bzenag kwenc̱he gaogake' xya c̱hegake' lao Chioza'.

Per beṉ'ki chṉetezgake' zban c̱he diika' bi chajni'gakile'. Nakgake' ka bayix̱'ka' baka' bi nteyi, baka' chaljgakb na' chzen beṉ' ḻegakb na' chitgake'b. Ka'kzan gak c̱he beṉ'ka', ḻekzka' kwiayi'gake'.

Na' ikaagake' laxji dii mala' ba bengake'. Beṉ'ki chakgakile' zix̱ sia choe'gake' cho'a xbayi beli chen c̱he'ka' ax̱t tellatekzə. Na' kat' chlengake' le' cheej chaole, bi nxe bi nzak' nakgake' daa chibagakile' chongake' daa nazan c̱hegake'.

Nottezə noolə ile'gakile' chzelall'gake'ne', na' bi chelj chlla'gakile' gongake' saaxyana'. Na' chgooyeḻ'gake' beṉ'ka' biṉ' gakcha lo xṉez Chioza' kwenc̱he gongake' dii mala', na' ḻe chzelall'gake' gat' kwe'gakile'. Beṉ'ki chon ka' ba nakten kwiayi'gake'.
Ba wlej yic̱hjgake' nez ḻi c̱he Chioza' na' ba zejgake' lo nez daa wyoo Balaama' xiiṉ Beora', beena' wyoolall' sho' laxje' c̱he dii mala' bene'.
Na' ni c̱he dii mala' nan gone', to burr, ba bi chak iṉe, wṉeb ka beṉ' na' bsheshlem ḻe' kwenc̱he bi gone' dii mala' ba ngoo yic̱hje' gone' daa nc̱hoḻ nitile'.
Beṉ' malki zaklebgakile' beja' daa bich bi nis chal, na' ka bejka' choa' be'na'. Ba nchoglo c̱hegake' soagake' zejḻi kaṉi gana' ḻiizelozi nak shgasj shc̱hoḻ.

Chṉegake' cha'sibə choe'gake' dill' dii bibi zakii, na' chgooyeḻ'gake' beṉ'ka' kayaadia ba bichejgake' ladj beṉ'ka' chon dii mala' kwenc̱he sto shii yizologake' yiyoe'gake' cho'a xbayi beli chen c̱he'ka'.
Na' che'gake' wak gongake' daa nazan c̱hegake', ḻa' aga bi xya c̱he dii mala' de, na' ḻe'yeṉ'gaken' ntakw nc̱hej dii mala'. Ḻa' nottezə beṉ' chone' kon ka na daa chṉabia' ḻe', ba ndo'e lawinna'.

Na' beṉ'ka' ba biyell bila'gake' lao dii mala' daa de yell-lioni daa ba benḻilall'gake' X̱ancho Jesucrístona', beena' bisla cho', shi sto shii yitakw yic̱hej dii mala' ḻegake', gaktechlə mal c̱hegake' aga ka gok c̱hegake' dii nech kana' biṉ' gonḻilall'gake'ne'.
Wenchlan sheḻ' bi bembia'kzgake' nez ḻi c̱he Chioza' aga ka daa bembia'gake'n na' biḻaala'ogake' cho'a xtilleena' daa bli' bsedi beṉ' ḻegake'.
Na' daa bengake' ka', billinin c̱he dillaa de daa na: “Bekwaa chiyaob daa biyebb, na' kusha', bana' zi' gozj, chibix̱ chitoḻb ḻoo beṉja' sto shii.”
